proposals.evidence: Turner gives Doda ṭalla clothes and Western Pahari ṭalo cloth, alongside Nepali ṭālo piece of cloth. The adjacent Dogri/Gujari tal(l)- survey responses fit this cloth family; the source dental spelling is preserved, so this is explicitly a regional lexical comparison rather than a claimed exact phonetic match.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s gaṭṭa piece family includes Punjabi gaṭṭ/gaṭṭā and, explicitly in the addenda, Western Pahari gɔṭṭɔ and gaṭi small stone/pebble. The Awankari, Pothwari and Gujari stone responses match that northwestern lexical family. i-vowel giṭṭ- forms and responses combining different words are excluded.
